title: T112 (Tinyana) PNC - If You Believe You Can Spoil, Believe You Can Fix
hebrewTitle: אם אתה מאמין שיכולים לקלקל — תאמין שיכולים לתקן
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Le-inyan his-chazkus, le-val yipoil ha-adam be-da'ato me-chamas ribbui ha-pegamim ve-ha-kilkulim she-kilkel al-yedei ma'asav — anah ve-amar: im atah ma'amin, she-yecholin le-kalkel — ta'amin she-yecholin le-saken.** This single line is the Breslov axe against ye'ush. **Hesder ha-tiv'i shel ha-mesarev me-chazak**: he believes — *with painful clarity* — that he has *been the source of damage*. Rabbeinu turns the very *emunah he already holds* against him: *that same emunah obligates the symmetric emunah*: *if you believe in your power to spoil, the same belief — same actor, same world — demands belief in your power to fix.* **The asymmetric weakness is not modesty; it is a hidden privileging of the kelipah over kedushah.** *Ta'amin* — *be-osah ha-emunah atzmah* — that *you* can *fix*.

intermediate.en: **Klal**: *im ma'amin she-yecholin le-kalkel — ta'amin she-yecholin le-saken*. **Mehlokei ha-tiv'i (asimetri) = chassah lo-medudah el ha-kelipah**: ha-emunah ba-yecholes le-kalkel mechayeves ha-emunah ba-yecholes le-saken. *Ein ha-temimus = ye'ush*.

scholarly.he: [T2:112א] רבינו: "אם אתה מאמין שיכולים לקלקל, תאמין שיכולים לתקן." אסימטריה באמונה = ייאוש מוסווה.
